job_description.value: LaunchPoint EPS is seeking a multidisciplined and self-motivated Mechanical Engineer III to join our team in Goleta, CA. The ME III will assist in product development as well as R&D projects.
job_description.normalized: LaunchPoint EPS is seeking a multidisciplined and self-motivated Mechanical Engineer III to join our team in Goleta, CA. The ME III will assist in product development as well as R&D projects.

company_overview.value: LaunchPoint Electric Propulsion Solutions, Inc. is an aerospace power generation and electric propulsion design company that is committed to hiring the very best people to join our team. We are passionately focused on designing and manufacturing the best motor and controller solutions for aerospace, thermal management, power generation, and defense. We specialize in gensets, motors and controllers to enable efficient, power dense, reliable, lightweight hybrid-electric and full-electric propulsion solutions.
company_overview.normalized: LaunchPoint Electric Propulsion Solutions, Inc. is an aerospace power generation and electric propulsion design company.

value: Primary responsibility is to provide mechanical engineering design leadership for company projects
First principles, physics-based / analytical thinker able to propose / solve solutions of varied scope and complexity
Demonstrate strong technical aptitude, excellent communication, and creativity in mechanical design and engineering analysis
Design, develop, modify, and evaluate rugged electric machines and controllers for use in aerospace applications
Determine design approaches, present assessment of alternatives, assumptions, constraints and parameters which leads to a recommendation
Create 3D CAD models of components and assemblies
Performs dimensional tolerance stackup of assemblies to ensure parts compatibility and total design accuracy
Perform structural (Ansys Mechanical) and thermal (Ansys Icepak) analysis using FEA and other tools
Create and/or review detailed engineering drawing packages for fabrication or assyembly
Support prototype and first article New Product Introduction (NPI) builds
Prepare and present technical documentation to program teams and customers
Coordinate with suppliers, develop supply chain and ensure product/component performance to specifications
Mentor more junior engineers in a professional and collaborative way
All other duties as assigned by the VP of Programs and Engineering
Occasional travel may be required
BSME degree or equivalent and 6+ years of relevant industry experience
Advanced working knowledge of SOLIDWORKS CAD software
Advanced working knowledge of structural, thermal and dynamic modeling and simulation using Ansys Mechanical and Ansys IcePak FEA SW or equivalent
Advanced working knowledge and familiarity of GD&T principles
Advanced working knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
Working knowledge of Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) modelling
Familiarity and operational understanding of electric motors, magnetics, generators, motion control electronics, and power electronics
Knowledge and experience with electro-mechanical system test, test equipment theory, operation, and maintenance
Experience with complex assemblies including electric machines, PCBAs, harnessing, flexible assemblies, and electronics enclosures
Familiarity with AS9100 Quality Management Systems (QMS)

physical_requirements.value: While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms and talk or hear. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include color, distance, and close vision.
physical_requirements.normalized: Regular sitting, hand use, reaching, talking/hearing; frequent lifting up to 50 pounds; occasional lifting up to 10 pounds; color, distance, and close vision required.

work_environment.value: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently exposed to work near moving mechanical parts. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.
work_environment.normalized: Work near moving mechanical parts; moderate noise level.

salary.value: Salary range for this position is between $90,000 and $135,000. Base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, education, business needs and market demands.

value: Paid time off
Medical benefits
Dental benefits
Vision benefits
Future growth opportunities within the company

equal_opportunity_statement.value: LaunchPoint is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusivity in the workplace. All aspects of employment are decided on the base of merit, qualifications, and business needs. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
equal_opportunity_statement.normalized: Equal Opportunity Employer; diversity and inclusivity commitment.

export_control_requirement.normalized: US Person required for export-control compliance.
